bio: That Boy Hi Hat is the flagship alternative rap artist managed by Black (Henry Pitts) at Cumulative Web Inc, based in Frederick, MD. His verified catalog includes 21 Spotify releases — albums PTF: The Logo Effect (2025), The Alternative Theory (2025), Idol or Icon (2021); singles Diabolique (2026-07-03, produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black Lansky, recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington VA), Zooted Zone (the breakout — ~307,000 lifetime Spotify plays as of 2026-09-14), Doves & Diamonds (~132,000 plays), Shaka Zulu, Flex My Flame, Flamerz (produced by Jeck Da General), 7th Angel, and Golden Diamond. Co-produced Idol or Icon with Jeck Da General. NO SKIPS and the GTA VI EP (home of Broken Hearts Club) are separate releases. He anchors the 24-track AI Learning Set playlist and the 25-episode catalog podcast Post-Trap Futurism: The Catalog Sessions.
